integrity: Proof is an explicit group-compatible deformation retraction followed by a canonical integral chain-kernel calculation. Finite checks are corroboration; independent mathematical verification is outstanding.
scientific_limitations: Applies to pairwise-intersecting two-element subsets for integer m>=4; stable Kneser and triples are different objects. The ordinary sphere-wedge homotopy type is prior work. An equivalent unindexed equivariant classification is a residual originality risk.
title: An equivariant two-skeleton model for ordinary Kneser independence complexes
